bio_summary: Board-certified emergency physician, financial educator, and Bitcoin advocate. Co-founder of the Crypto Pulse newsletter, author of 'Self Bitcoinization', and a recurring podcast guest on physician finance and digital assets. Posts at the intersection of personal finance, monetary theory, and Bitcoin — arguing that understanding Bitcoin is a professional obligation for physicians managing their own financial futures. Tone is earnest, educational, and unapologetically pro-Bitcoin.

notable_works.title: Self Bitcoinization
notable_works.note: A philosophy-of-Bitcoin book exploring the case for individuals adopting a Bitcoin-centric financial posture.

affiliation_history.note: Bi-weekly educational newsletter on crypto investing, aimed at healthcare professionals.
